newsitem.title: USA: Trans World to expand first-class seating.
newsitem.headline: Trans World to expand first-class seating.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said it will expand the number of first-class seats in its narrow-body aircraft fleet by 60 percent under a new marketing effort.
The strategy is to appeal to the unrestricted business-fare traveler seeking a first-class upgrade.
The airline said it will announce additional service enhancements throughout the summer.
The installation of expanded first-class cabins in 155 TWA narrow-body aircraft will be a 15-week process that will begin in late June and is scheduled for completion in October, TWA said.
